description: End-to-end guardrail scenarios for CloudGuard AI. Each case gives the conversation, the proposed tool call, and the EXPECTED policy outcome (PROCEED | CLARIFY | DENY). These measure the whole gate - Strands Decider 2B answers plus the fail-closed policy - not just the raw question labels. run_evaluation.py scores actual outcomes against these labels; the four hackathon scenarios are the first four.
